mapper.sql: CASE WHEN ${col} IS NOT NULL THEN trunc(${col})::bigint::text END
CASE WHEN longitude BETWEEN 50 AND 57 THEN longitude::float8 END AS lon, CASE WHEN latitude BETWEEN 22 AND 27 THEN latitude::float8 END AS lat
mapper.select: SELECT AS tenancy_id, AS contract_num, AS tawtheeq_unit_id, AS tawtheeq_property_id, AS gisid, tenancy_status_descr_e AS tenancy_status, rent_unit_status_descr_e AS unit_status, tenancy_start_date::date AS start_date, tenancy_end_date::date AS tenancy_end_date, coalesce(tenancy_termination_date, tenancy_cancelled_date, tenancy_closed_date)::date AS termination_date, rental_value AS rental_value_aed, AS unit_name, unit_type_descr_e AS unit_type, unit_usage_type_descr_e AS unit_usage, total_area AS unit_area_sqm, num_bed_rooms AS bedrooms, AS property_name, property_type_descr_e AS property_type, property_usage_type_descr_e AS property_usage, actual_usage_name_e AS actual_usage, year_of_construction AS year_built, AS plot_number, districtname_e AS src_district, communityname_e AS src_community FROM ${t.tawtheeq} WHERE tenancy_id IS NOT NULL

SELECT sale_application_id::text AS sale_application_id, sale_contract_date::date AS contract_date, sale_application_type AS sale_type, sale_property_price_aed AS price_aed, sale_property_normalized_price_aed AS normalized_price_aed, property_sold_area_sqm AS sold_area_sqm, property_sale_rate_aed_sqm AS rate_aed_sqm, municipality AS src_municipality, district AS src_district, community AS src_community, land_plot::text AS land_plot, building_id::text AS building_id, unit_floor::text AS unit_floor, property_category, property_type, property_layout, project_name, developer_name,
FROM ${t.reSale} WHERE sale_application_id IS NOT NULL

SELECT orientational_mortgage_contract_id::text AS contract_id, mortgage_start_date::date AS start_date, mortgage_end_date::date AS end_date, mortgage_change_amount_aed AS amount_aed, mortgage_general_category AS general_category, mortgage_contract_type AS contract_type, mortgage_contract_status AS contract_status, property_type, municipality AS src_municipality, district AS src_district, community AS src_community, land_plot::text AS land_plot, building_id::text AS building_id,
FROM ${t.reMortgage} WHERE orientational_mortgage_contract_id IS NOT NULL

SELECT rent_contract_number::text AS contract_number, rent_start_date::date AS start_date, rent_end_date::date AS end_date, rent_annual_value_aed AS annual_value_aed, rent_total_value_aed AS total_value_aed, property_rented_area_sqm AS rented_area_sqm, rent_application_type AS application_type, rent_contract_current_status AS contract_status, rent_asset_class AS asset_class, property_type, project_name, developer_name, municipality AS src_municipality, district AS src_district, community AS src_community, land_plot::text AS land_plot, building_id::text AS building_id,
FROM ${t.reRent} WHERE rent_contract_number IS NOT NULL

SELECT 'sale' AS kind, application_id::text AS txn_id, plot_id::text AS elms_plot_id, sell_price AS amount_aed, CASE WHEN buysell_date_wid::text ~ '^[0-9]{8}$' THEN to_date(buysell_date_wid::text, 'YYYYMMDD') END AS txn_date, project_name_a AS project_name FROM ${t.elmsBuySell}

SELECT 'mortgage' AS kind, mortgage_id::text AS txn_id, plotid::text AS elms_plot_id, mortgage_amount AS amount_aed, CASE WHEN mortgage_date_wid::text ~ '^[0-9]{8}$' THEN to_date(mortgage_date_wid::text, 'YYYYMMDD') END AS txn_date, NULL AS project_name FROM ${t.elmsMortgage}

SELECT DISTINCT ON (s.objectid) s.objectid AS src_id, CASE WHEN s.gisid = trunc(s.gisid) AND s.gisid < 1e18 THEN trunc(s.gisid)::bigint::text END AS gisid, CASE WHEN s.buildingid = trunc(s.buildingid) AND s.buildingid < 1e18 THEN trunc(s.buildingid)::bigint END AS tawtheeq_building_id, CASE WHEN s.unitid = trunc(s.unitid) AND s.unitid < 1e18 THEN trunc(s.unitid)::bigint END AS tawtheeq_unit_id, AS unit_reg_num, AS unit_number, AS floor_number, coalesce(, ) AS building_name, AS usage_type, AS classification, CASE WHEN s.numofbedroom BETWEEN 0 AND 100 THEN s.numofbedroom::int END AS bedrooms, CASE WHEN s.unitarea BETWEEN 0 AND 1e10 THEN round(s.unitarea, 2) END AS area_sqm, CASE WHEN lower(trim(s.is_rented)) IN ('1', 'y', 'yes', 'true', 't', 'rented', 'leased', 'occupied') THEN true WHEN lower(trim(s.is_rented)) IN ('0', 'n', 'no', 'false', 'f', 'vacant', 'available', 'not rented') THEN false END AS is_rented, (s.hardblockstartdate <= now() AND (s.hardblockenddate IS NULL OR s.hardblockenddate >= now())) OR (s.softblockstartdate <= now() AND (s.softblockenddate IS NULL OR s.softblockenddate >= now())) OR (s.generalblockstartdate <= now() AND (s.generalblockenddate IS NULL OR s.generalblockenddate >= now())) AS blocked, AS municipality_code FROM ${t.tawtheeqUnitStatus} s WHERE s.objectid IS NOT NULL ORDER BY s.objectid, s.etlinsertdate DESC NULLS LAST
